$comment: hooks is merged per event: an event named here replaces the machine's
version of that event, and an event the machine has that this file does
not mention is left alone. statusLine is replaced outright; env is merged
per key with this file winning; autoUpdatesChannel and minimumVersion are
an update floor, not a preference, so they come from here too. Every
other key keeps whatever the machine already had, so model, effortLevel,
enabledPlugins and friends survive a re-bootstrap.
Every key below is one the installed CLI actually reads -- verified
against a live settings.json, not guessed from documentation.
Hook commands point only at files the installer itself writes: plugin
cache paths carry a version number and go stale on the next update, so
the hooks in claude/hooks/ resolve plugins at run time instead.
